name: Position-only ChordRes with unrestricted token controls
tagline: Normalized position generates signed read, position and velocity coefficients.
description: A width-D affine map at each attention and MLP site reads normalized position. Its outputs directly control physical lookahead, position steps, velocity retention and parallel/perpendicular writes.
mechanism: Normalized position conditions each affine token gate
The six consumed controls can take any real value
Fused Chord reads and writes retain the original physical velocity
limitations: Research run with matched random output projections and a high Chord learning rate.
